title: Skeleton SOTA AI Application Construction Contract
purpose: Canonical machine-readable build manual for constructing, assembling, validating, operating, and evolving the complete AI application without architecture gaps.

provider_bootstrap.rule: Every AI development agent and every credential-bearing AI provider activation must load the active architecture, construction, capability-interface, and manual contracts before changing or serving the system.

quality_attributes.correctness: Contract-first boundaries, deterministic validators, typed provider-neutral interfaces, evidence-backed release gates.
quality_attributes.availability: Bounded retries, circuit breaking, graceful degradation, durable checkpoints, provider failover, recovery drills.
quality_attributes.latency: Fast-path routing, streaming, caches, async I/O, parallel validation, isolated accelerators, budget-aware model selection.
quality_attributes.security: Least privilege, sealed secrets, SSRF-safe provider endpoints, input/output bounds, sandboxed tools, auditable authority.
quality_attributes.privacy: Explicit data classes, minimization, retention/deletion policy, tenant isolation, provider privacy ceilings.
quality_attributes.observability: Request/trace correlation, structured logs, metrics, cost/latency/quality telemetry, SLOs and evidence receipts.
quality_attributes.evolvability: Canonical owners, adapters before migrations, capability contracts, compatibility windows, architecture drift gates.

build_principles: provider-neutral core with provider-specific adapters at the edge
fail closed on authority, secrets, provider registration, architecture drift, and destructive actions
bounded resource usage at every untrusted boundary
migration by domain and interface, never by blind history merge

construction_phases.goal: Freeze canonical contracts and bootstrap rules before implementation.
Establish identity, persistence, security and observability required by every higher plane.
Make provider execution neutral, declared, measurable, bounded and routable.
Construct governed memory, retrieval and context assembly.
Construct orchestration, reasoning verification and durable job execution.
Enable tools and artifacts with explicit authority and receipts.
Expose stable engine/application APIs and realtime progress.
Assemble the human product around the canonical service boundaries.
Prove quality, safety, resilience and learning discipline.
Produce reproducible, observable, reversible production releases.
Evolve by measured domain changes while preserving all contracts.
